data.goal: Build, test, and ship MONOTERMINAL per docs/monoterminal-srs.md v1.2: a Rust master terminal daemon (Windows-first, ConPTY + wgpu/egui rendering, P2P WebRTC networking, WebSocket+Protobuf+TLS1.3 wire protocol, Ed25519/JWT auth + RBAC, SQLite persistence) paired with a single React+xterm.js PWA web client, deeply integrated with monomind (per-session detection, embedded dashboard, health/upgrade). Deliver through the phased roadmap: Phase 1 Windows+Web MVP, Phase 2 P2P+persistence+collaboration, Phase 3 Linux/macOS expansion, Phase 4 enterprise readiness — hitting the SRS's 80% coverage, 60 FPS, <30ms LAN p95, and 1000-concurrent-session targets at each gate.
